user.title: Connect BOLOLO
user.description: Enter your app phone number without its country calling code. SMS is selected by default; submitting requests one code. Password login is also available. Setup retrieves bound devices and prefers LAN.

data.username: Phone number (email also supported for password login)

sms.title: Verify SMS code
sms.description: Enter the code from your SMS. The code is never stored. To request another code, select Resend and submit; wait at least 60 seconds between requests. If retrieving devices fails temporarily, submit again to continue.

captcha.title: Image verification
captcha.description:
Enter the characters in the image to request your SMS code.

![Verification image]({captcha_image})

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the BOLOLO cloud. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The account, password or country code was rejected.
error.invalid_account: Enter a valid phone number and country calling code.
error.invalid_code: The code was rejected or expired. Check it or request another code.
error.code_required: Enter your SMS code or select Resend.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait at least 60 seconds after the previous SMS request.
error.sms_rate_limit: SMS requests are rate limited. Try again later.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in to the same BOLOLO account as this integration.

init.title: Connection settings
init.description: Choose a connection mode. Optionally select a device to override its LAN address or passcode. LAN-only mode uses the cached inventory without refreshing cloud account bindings.

device.title: {device}
device.description: The integration discovers addresses and obtains local passcodes automatically. An IPv4 override assists discovery; allow UDP 12414, 2415 and TCP 12416. Passcodes normally do not need to be entered. Leave a field blank to clear its override.
